items.title: Lightspeed targets $250M for new India fund, focusing on early-stage AI
items.summary: The venture firm is aligning its India fundraising cycle with its global funds for the first time, as it shifts to a shorter investment period.

items.title: PrismML brings its tiny LLMs to Qualcomm-powered smart glasses
items.summary: Prism's larger goal is open-weight AI that runs on devices and makes better use of the computing power they already have.

items.title: Oracle sends force majeure notice on its New Mexico Stargate data center
items.summary: The notice would allow Oracle to delay payments should the facility miss its 2028 target to come online.

items.title: Meta’s Muse Charm looks like a Tamagotchi, but it’s tapping into a much newer trend
items.summary: Meta’s new AI gadget may look like a Tamagotchi, but its dangling form factor taps into a much broader Gen Z trend around bag charms, retro tech, and turning gadgets into fashion accessories.

items.title: Google Photos ‘Clueless’-inspired virtual closet is now available on Android and iOS
items.summary: The AI-powered feature builds a virtual wardrobe from your photos, and is now broadly available after first rolling out to Android users in June.

items.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026: Everything you need to know
items.summary: TechCrunch Founder Summit is a full-day gathering in Boston on November 4 where founders across all stages connect with top VCs and experienced entrepreneurs to gain tactical insights on building and scaling their companies.

items.title: ElevenLabs’ CEO on margins, IPO timing, and telling customers they’re talking to a bot
items.summary: ElevenLabs powers the AI voice on the other end of a lot of customer service calls, and its CEO told me this week that businesses should probably tell you that — at least until getting a machine is what everyone expects anyway.

items.summary: Lovable co-founder Fabian Hedin said that apps created on the platform are getting nearly a billion monthly views each month.

items.summary: The app gives agents their own identities and inboxes and lets them partake in conversations as naturally as people can.

items.title: Australia to investigate if OpenAI hack of government health website broke the law
items.summary: The incident is the first known breach to affect a government agency, and Australia's prime minister has vowed to hold OpenAI accountable.

items.title: Everything new coming to Meta’s AI agent Muse
items.summary: CEO Mark Zuckerberg kicked off the company’s annual Connect event in Menlo Park on Wednesday with a keynote that made one thing clear: Meta is going all-in on Muse. It's even coming to Meta's AI glasses.

items.title: Meta made a Tamagotchi-like wearable for its Muse AI agent
items.summary: The tiny hardware device creates another mobile home for its AI agent Muse.

items.title: Meta introduces camera-free AI glasses
items.summary: Meta says the camera-free glasses will be lighter and have up to 12 hours of battery life.
